briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent capabilities amid intensifying compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 new models this month as quarterly funding hit $11.9B. Multi-agent systems now dominate benchmarks while regulatory pressure mounts on safety.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3 Ultra followed within days. Meta open-sourced Llama 4.1 while xAI and DeepSeek pushed inference speed records.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic workflows.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reached 1.4M units; Microsoft and Google announced $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10-trillion-parameter model trigger an irreversible acceleration phase before 2027?
